value.body: A content writer writes articles, blogs, web pages, newsletters and social posts for brands, agencies and publications. Employers include digital marketing agencies, startups, edtech and media companies, and many writers work freelance. A typical day involves researching topics, writing and revising drafts to a brief, and optimising text for search.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Any degree; B.A. English, Journalism or Mass Communication are common

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Google Docs, a CMS such as WordPress, SEO tools, grammar checkers

items.label: Digital media segment revenue
items.note: Industry estimate (₹802 billion), the largest M&E segment
items.source: FICCI-EY M&E report 2025, as cited in a PIB backgrounder (Feb 2026)

items.label: India's media & entertainment sector
items.note: Digital media is about one-third of this
items.source: FICCI-EY M&E report 2025, as cited in a PIB backgrounder (Feb 2026)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually get in with a portfolio of writing samples (a blog or published pieces) and a writing test. Internships at agencies and freelance projects are common first steps.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Writing to a brief and brand tone

value.title: At a glance
items: AI writing tools have changed the work; editing and subject knowledge carry more weight.
Next roles: senior writer, content strategist, editor.
Freelance pay and workload can be uneven.

competition.note: BA (all subjects) graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
